description: Send a message the user will read verbatim. Use this for content they need to see exactly as written between tool calls — a generated code snippet, a specific value, a direct reply to something they asked mid-task. Don't use it for routine narration of what you're about to do, or for your final answer — normal text reaches them for those.
name: SendUserMessage

message.description: The message for the user. Supports markdown formatting.
